items.stem: Write a short dialogue between Ravi and Grandpa after Ravi opens the gift-wrapped parcel and realizes he was tricked during the morning walk.
items.answer: Ravi: (Laughing as he looks at the book) A detective storybook? Very funny, Grandpa! You knew I was following you the whole time, didn’t you? Grandpa: (With a mischievous wink) Of course, Ravi! You crawling behind those elephant-shaped bushes wasn’t exactly invisible to me. Ravi: But how did you manage the yellow cap trick? I was absolutely horrified when I saw a stranger wearing it! Grandpa: A good detective never reveals his best secrets! I just thought you needed some practical lessons on how to trail a suspect properly. Ravi: I was sick with worry, Grandpa. But I’m so glad you’re safe. Also, happy birthday! Mom totally forgot, didn’t she? Grandpa: Thank you, my boy. Yes, she did. Maybe she’s the one who needs “Vitamin-M”!

items.stem: Imagine you are Grandpa. Write a letter to an old friend in your village describing your new life in the city and your secret morning adventure.
items.answer: Dear Ashok, I hope this letter finds you well. Life in the city is quite different. I deeply miss my small brick house and the comforting shade of our old mango tree. My daughter means well, but she treats me like a fragile prisoner, constantly worrying about my memory and feeding me “Vitamin-M.” However, I haven’t lost my spark just yet! Today, I went for a morning stroll and treated myself to sugary tea, bananas, and even cold ice cream. My grandson, Ravi, tried to play detective and tail me. I taught him a practical lesson by swapping my yellow cap with a stranger on a bus! I arrived home long before he did. It feels wonderful to know I can still outwit the young ones. Warmly, Grandpa

items.stem: Discuss the significance of “Vitamin-M” in the story. How does the author use irony to convey a powerful message about memory and aging?
items.answer: “Vitamin-M” or the “memory vitamin” serves as a central symbol of the mother’s patronising attitude toward Grandpa’s aging process. Because of a few minor lapses, she treats him as cognitively impaired, enforcing strict regimens. The author brilliantly flips this narrative using situational irony. While Grandpa playfully outsmarts a teenage boy—proving his mind is as sharp and strategic as ever—it is the younger, supposedly capable mother who suffers a massive memory failure. She completely forgets her own father’s birthday, a highly significant emotional milestone. This irony highlights that aging does not equate to complete incompetence, and sometimes, the younger generation’s superficial, clinical care blinds them to what truly matters in a family.

items.stem: What role do the banned snacks (sugary tea, bananas, and ice cream) play in the narrative? What do they symbolize for Grandpa?
items.answer: In the narrative, the banned snacks—sugary tea, large bananas, and cold ice cream—serve as powerful symbols of Grandpa’s lost autonomy and his enduring zest for life. Under his daughter’s roof, his diet is strictly monitored for health reasons, reducing his daily life to a series of restrictive, joyless rules. When Grandpa sneaks away to the roadside tea stall to indulge in these specific treats, he is not merely satisfying a physical hunger; he is staging a quiet, triumphant rebellion. These snacks symbolize his reclaiming of independence, joy, and the simple human right to make his own choices. It demonstrates that his spirit remains youthful and vibrant, refusing to be entirely subdued by age or strict parenting.

items.stem: How does Grandpa’s birthday tradition of gifting others reflect his values and impact his relationship with his family?
items.answer: Grandpa’s tradition of giving gifts on his own birthday is a profound reflection of his generous, selfless nature. Instead of expecting to be pampered or celebrated, he finds immense joy in making his family—especially Ravi—feel special. This tradition starkly contrasts with his daughter’s clinical, rule-based approach to his care. When he gifts Ravi the detective storybook, it serves multiple beautiful purposes: it playfully mocks Ravi’s failed tracking mission, imparts a gentle life lesson, and reinforces a bond of friendship rather than authority between grandfather and grandson. items.stem: SUMMARY Introduction to a World of Courage The chapter “The World of Limitless Possibilities” explores the inspiring world of para-sports and the extraordinary athletes who participate in the Paralympic Games. It introduces students to the idea that physical limitations cannot restrict human potential if one has strong willpower. The chapter opens with the powerful example of Sheetal Devi, an armless para-archer who won the Arjuna Award in 2024. By shooting arrows with incredible precision using her feet, she sets the perfect tone for the chapter: with determination, anyone can overcome daunting obstacles and aim high. The Inspiring Journey of Dr. Deepa Malik The core of the chapter is based on an interview with Dr. Deepa Malik, a legendary Indian para- athlete. At the age of 29, Dr. Malik was diagnosed with a spinal tumour. After her surgery, she was left paralysed from the waist down and was told she would be bound to a wheelchair for the rest of her life. Faced with this massive tragedy, she had two choices: to spend her life crying over her condition, or to transform her life into a “world of limitless possibilities.” Because she always loved sports and was a swimmer, she courageously chose the latter and switched to para-athletics. Her transformation is compared to a caterpillar turning into a beautiful butterfly, showing how she used her struggles to emerge stronger. Breakthrough Achievements and Milestones Dr. Malik’s hard work led to spectacular success. Her ultimate “breakthrough moment” came during the 2016 Rio Paralympic Games, where she won the silver medal in the shot-put event. She holds many historic “firsts” for the country. She is the first-ever Indian female para- athlete to win an Asian Games medal in athletics, and India’s first-ever female Paralympic medallist across any sport. Because of her incredible success, she was named one of the top 10 most effective para-athletes by the International Paralympic Committee and was honoured with prestigious Indian awards, including the Padma Shri, Arjuna Award, and Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna. Challenging Stereotypes and Changing Perceptions A major theme of the chapter is how sports can change the way society looks at people with disabilities. Historically, society has often viewed disabled individuals as helpless. Dr. Malik’s achievements completely shatter this stereotype. items.stem: Explain how Dr. Malik’s achievements challenge societal perceptions.
items.answer: Dr. Malik’s achievements dismantle the deep- rooted societal perception that physical disability equates to inability. By winning coveted medals at the highest international levels, such as the Asian Games and the Paralympics, she proved that individuals with disabilities possess immense physical strength, skill, and a fierce competitive spirit. Her success forces society to look at “ability beyond disability” rather than focusing on limitations.

items.section_heading: Answer the following questions.
items.stem: What can be the long-term impact of involving youth in schools and colleges in advocacy with respect to disability?
items.answer: Involving youth in disability advocacy helps create a more inclusive and empathetic generation. Since the youth are the “voice of tomorrow,” educating them early breaks down preconceived notions before they become deeply ingrained. In the long term, this leads to a society that naturally builds inclusive infrastructure, implements fair policies, and treats everyone with dignity and equality.

items.answer: The title “The World of Limitless Possibilities” is highly appropriate because it mirrors Dr. Deepa Malik’s life philosophy. Faced with a paralysing spine tumour at 29, she refused to squander her life in remorse. Instead, she viewed her setbacks as stepping stones. Her unprecedented achievements—like being India’s first female Paralympic medallist—demonstrate that when one shifts their focus from physical limitations to inner potential, the possibilities for success are truly limitless.

items.stem: Examine how Dr. Deepa Malik’s recognition as one of the 10 most inspirational para-athletes globally contributes to the larger discourse on gender equality in sports.
items.answer: Dr. Deepa Malik’s global recognition strongly champions both disability rights and gender equality. Historically, sports have been male- dominated, and para-sports even more so. By excelling in this arena and earning a spot among the top 10 most inspirational para-athletes globally, she serves as a trailblazer. Her success highlights that women, even those facing severe physical challenges, possess the same competitive drive and potential as men, thereby advocating for equal opportunities and support for female athletes worldwide.

items.stem: How might Dr. Deepa Malik’s thought, ‘ability beyond disability’, serve as a guideline for success for all future para-athletes?
items.answer: The thought “ability beyond disability” encourages future para-athletes to focus intensely on what they can do rather than what they cannot. It shifts the narrative from seeking sympathy to showcasing strength, skill, and determination. By adopting this mindset, future athletes can overcome societal stereotypes and their own mental barriers, reminding them that their potential is defined by hard work and talent, not by physical constraints.

items.section_heading: Interview the Sports Captain and the Sports
items.stem: How does Sheetal Devi’s achievement set the tone for the chapter “Limitless Possibilities”?
items.answer: Sheetal Devi, an incredible para-archer who shoots precisely using her feet and won the 2024 Arjuna Award, perfectly introduces the chapter’s theme. Her story establishes that physical limitations can be completely conquered, setting an inspiring, resilient tone for the text.

items.section_heading: Interview the Sports Captain and the Sports
items.stem: What role does willpower play in the lives of para- athletes like Sheetal Devi?
items.answer: Willpower acts as the ultimate driving force for para-athletes. The chapter emphasizes that strong determination and mental fortitude empower individuals to look beyond their physical constraints, helping them achieve extraordinary feats and conquer unimaginable obstacles on global sporting platforms.

items.section_heading: Interview the Sports Captain and the Sports
items.stem: Describe the sudden tragic turn in Deepa Malik’s life when she was twenty-nine.
items.answer: At the age of twenty-nine, Deepa Malik faced a devastating medical crisis when she was diagnosed with a spinal tumour. Following her surgery, she was left completely paralyzed from the waist down, effectively confining her to a wheelchair for life.

items.section_heading: Interview the Sports Captain and the Sports
items.stem: Confronted with lifelong paralysis, what were the two distinct paths available to Deepa Malik, and which did she choose?
items.answer: Faced with irreversible paralysis, Deepa had two stark choices: either cry over her tragic circumstances or proactively create limitless possibilities. Demonstrating immense mental strength, she chose the latter, transforming her deep setback into a stepping stone for monumental athletic success.

items.section_heading: Interview the Sports Captain and the Sports
items.stem: Why is Deepa Malik’s transition into para- athletics compared to a butterfly emerging from a chrysalis?
items.answer: The comparison to a butterfly perfectly captures her stunning metamorphosis. Just as a caterpillar transforms through struggle, Deepa used her painful personal tragedies and paralysis to evolve, emerging much stronger and finding a beautiful new identity in the world of para-athletics.

items.section_heading: Interview the Sports Captain and the Sports
items.stem: State the significance of the 2016 Rio Paralympic Games in Dr. Deepa Malik’s athletic career.
items.answer: The 2016 Rio Paralympic Games marked the ultimate breakthrough moment in Dr. Deepa Malik’s life. Competing in the shot-put event, she secured a historic silver medal, instantly catapulting her to global fame and cementing her status as a legendary athlete.

items.section_heading: Interview the Sports Captain and the Sports
items.stem: Apart from her Paralympic glory, what other historic “firsts” has Dr. Deepa Malik achieved for Indian women in para-sports?
items.answer: Beyond her Paralympic silver, Dr. Malik holds the distinguished honor of being India’s first female Paralympic medallist across any sport. Additionally, she proudly stands as the very first female para-athlete from India to win a medal at the Asian Games.

items.section_heading: Interview the Sports Captain and the Sports
items.stem: How did the International Paralympic Committee acknowledge Dr. Deepa Malik’s global impact?
items.answer: The International Paralympic Committee recognized her immense global influence and continuous advocacy by naming her among the top ten most effective para-athletes worldwide. This prestigious acknowledgment highlights her vital role as both a formidable competitor and a powerful inspirational figure.

items.section_heading: Interview the Sports Captain and the Sports
items.stem: Which prestigious national civilian and sports awards honor Dr. Deepa Malik’s monumental achievements?
items.answer: For her unparalleled dedication and historic sporting achievements, the Indian government has honored Dr. Deepa Malik with the Padma Shri, a highly prestigious civilian award, alongside the Khel Ratna Award, which is the absolute highest sporting honor in the country.

items.section_heading: Interview the Sports Captain and the Sports
items.stem: In what way do the medals won by Dr. Deepa Malik shatter the historical stereotypes associated with disabled individuals?
items.answer: Historically, society often viewed disabled individuals as completely helpless or dependent. Dr. Malik’s impressive collection of international medals entirely shatters this outdated stereotype, proving NODIA undeniably that differently-abled people possess immense competitive spirit, fierce independence, and extraordinary physical capabilities.

items.section_heading: Interview the Sports Captain and the Sports
items.stem: How does the Paralympic stage fundamentally shift global perspectives on differently-abled individuals?
items.answer: The Paralympics acts as a massive global stage that dramatically shifts the world’s focus away from a person’s disability. Instead, it powerfully highlights their extraordinary athletic ability, fierce determination, and resilience, forcing society to recognize their true, unlimited potential.

items.section_heading: Interview the Sports Captain and the Sports
items.stem: How has Dr. Deepa Malik utilized her platform to assist the government in improving sports in India?
items.answer: Utilizing her influential status as a legendary athlete, Dr. Deepa Malik works closely alongside the government. She actively participates in shaping and creating better, more inclusive sports policies that significantly benefit and support differently-abled athletes across the entire nation.

items.section_heading: Interview the Sports Captain and the Sports
items.stem: Mention the specific ways in which Dr. Malik works to uplift and empower women in society.
items.answer: Dr. Malik acts as a powerful champion for women’s empowerment by actively encouraging their participation in adventure sports. She breaks traditional gender and disability barriers, inspiring women to embrace thrilling challenges, build self-confidence, and reclaim their absolute independence in society.

items.section_heading: Interview the Sports Captain and the Sports
items.stem: How does Dr. Malik extend her support to budding athletes coming from underprivileged backgrounds?
items.answer: Recognizing the financial hurdles many disabled athletes face, Dr. Malik actively supports grassroot talents coming from much poorer backgrounds. She generously provides them with essential sporting equipment, ensuring that financial constraints do not crush their dreams of achieving athletic glory.

items.section_heading: Interview the Sports Captain and the Sports
items.stem: Why does Dr. Deepa Malik place a strong emphasis on advocating for emotional health alongside physical sports?
items.answer: Dr. Malik strongly advocates for emotional health because coping with a severe disability requires immense mental fortitude. She understands that physical training alone is insufficient; maintaining a positive, resilient psychological state is absolutely vital to overcome life’s darkest, most challenging moments.

items.section_heading: Interview the Sports Captain and the Sports
items.stem: Interpret the quote: “Every setback is an opportunity to prove your strength,” in the context of Deepa Malik’s life.
items.answer: This profound quote perfectly encapsulates Deepa’s journey. Instead of letting a tragic spinal tumour destroy her life, she utilized that immense setback as fuel. Her paralysis became the exact foundation upon which she built an extraordinary, world-record-breaking athletic legacy.

items.section_heading: Interview the Sports Captain and the Sports
items.stem: According to the chapter, why is it essential for society to focus on a person’s abilities rather than their disabilities?
items.answer: The chapter asserts that focusing on disabilities breeds unnecessary pity and limits human potential. Conversely, focusing entirely on abilities fosters empowerment, encourages independence, and allows society to witness the remarkable achievements and limitless possibilities that differently-abled individuals can truly offer.

items.section_heading: Interview the Sports Captain and the Sports
items.stem: Why does the chapter specifically aim to involve the youth in conversations about inclusivity and para-sports?
items.answer: The chapter specifically targets the youth to foster early awareness and open conversations. By educating younger generations, the text hopes to dismantle long-standing prejudices, ensuring tomorrow’s leaders naturally cultivate a mindset of genuine acceptance, respect, and proactive inclusion for everyone.

items.section_heading: Interview the Sports Captain and the Sports
items.stem: What are the key characteristics of the ideal future society envisioned at the conclusion of the chapter?
items.answer: The conclusion beautifully envisions a deeply inclusive and profoundly empathetic future society. It dreams of a world completely devoid of prejudice, where every single individual, regardless of their physical limitations, is treated with absolute equality, unwavering dignity, and profound respect. items.section_heading: Interview the Sports Captain and the Sports
items.stem: Imagine you are Deepa Malik on the day you were told you would be wheelchair-bound for life. Write a diary entry expressing your initial shock and your ultimate resolve to choose ‘limitless possibilities’ over despair.
items.answer: Dear Diary, Today was the most defining day of my existence. The doctors confirmed that the spinal tumour has paralyzed me from the waist down. The absolute finality of being bound to a wheelchair forever initially crushed my spirit. I felt profound grief for the swimmer I used to be. However, as the tears flowed, a quiet strength began to rise within me. I refuse to let this tragedy define my entire story. I have two stark choices: to continuously cry over this misfortune, or to boldly forge a path of limitless possibilities. I choose the latter. I will rebuild my life. My legs may be paralyzed, but my fiercely competitive spirit remains completely untouched and ready to conquer the world. Deepa

items.section_heading: Interview the Sports Captain and the Sports
items.stem: You are asked to deliver a morning assembly speech in your school inspired by Dr. Deepa Malik’s journey. Draft a speech motivating your peers to shift their focus from ‘disability’ to ‘ability’ and build an empathetic environment.
items.answer: Respected Principal, Teachers, and dear friends, Today, I stand before you to share the inspiring philosophy of “Limitless Possibilities,” beautifully demonstrated by legendary para-athletes like Dr. Deepa Malik. When a spinal tumour confined her to a wheelchair, she did not surrender. Instead, she won a historic silver medal at the Rio Paralympics. Her incredible journey teaches us a vital lesson: we must drastically shift our societal lens from ‘disability’ to ‘ability.’ For too long, differently-abled individuals have been viewed with unnecessary pity. It is our absolute responsibility, as the youth and future leaders, to completely shatter these outdated stereotypes. Let us actively build a deeply inclusive, highly empathetic society where everyone is treated with unwavering dignity, profound respect, and absolute equality. Thank you.

items.section_heading: Interview the Sports Captain and the Sports
items.stem: Write a letter to para-archer Sheetal Devi, congratulating her on her 2024 Arjuna Award. Express how her ability to shoot with her feet has inspired you to overcome your own personal, everyday challenges.
items.answer: Dear Sheetal Devi, I am writing to extend my heartiest congratulations to you for winning the prestigious Arjuna Award in 2024. Reading about your extraordinary journey in the chapter “Limitless Possibilities” left me completely spellbound. Learning that you shoot arrows with such precision using your feet truly changed my understanding of human strength and resilience. Whenever I face small academic challenges, I often become frustrated. However, your strong willpower and your refusal to let physical limitations control your life act as a powerful lesson for me. You have shown that true determination can overcome any obstacle. You are truly a national inspiration. Your courage and spirit motivate me to face my own challenges with confidence. I will always look up to you as a role model and try to apply your inspiring attitude in my daily life. Yours sincerely, Aakash
